headerDisplay: Number tiles for the Apple Home app. Each tile is a light sensor whose lux reading equals watts. If homebridge-pvs6 already has a Host and Serial Number set, you can leave those blank here.

host.title: PVS6 Host (optional)
host.description: Leave blank to reuse the homebridge-pvs6 settings.

serialNumber.title: PVS6 Serial Number (optional)
serialNumber.description: Leave blank to reuse the homebridge-pvs6 settings.

pollInterval.title: Update Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: The PVS6 is also polled by homebridge-pvs6 and the Sunflower app, so 30 seconds or more is recommended.

solarTodayTile.title: Add a "Solar Today" tile (watt-hours)
solarTodayTile.description: Resets at midnight. Shows Wh, so 24,350 means 24.35 kWh.
